Branches: Internal self returns true without a queued request.
Missing local PID, including old local creation, returns false.
Live local process without pending signals uses table lookup.
Pending signals and exiting processes use an ordered is-alive request; termination completes false.
Before returning a non-self result, admit incoming signals to the requester.
